candidate_wound.name: invisible non-directional semantic formatting controls
candidate_wound.observation: HeartbeatSkillPolicy rejects ISO controls and bidi-direction controls but currently permits U+200B ZERO WIDTH SPACE, U+2060 WORD JOINER, and U+FEFF BOM/zero-width no-break space inside human-facing semantic fields. Those characters can create invisible distinctions in labels, reasons, evidence, parser member names, and checkpoint identity while the visible operator surface appears unchanged.
candidate_wound.scope_discrimination: Preserve U+200D ZERO WIDTH JOINER and U+200C ZERO WIDTH NON-JOINER because they have legitimate grapheme/language shaping uses. Do not ban Unicode FORMAT wholesale.
candidate_wound.desired_consequence: A narrow pure source policy identifies only the three invisible presentation controls as unsafe. Parser/direct-source/scene consumers can then fail closed without rewriting legitimate Unicode. Source policy is not runtime proof until an existing consumer is wired.
